component.name: Letters
component.summary: Word processor for the GNOME desktop

description.p: Letters is a word processor for the GNOME desktop, part of the Hanthor Office Suite.
Features include rich text formatting, Markdown editing, document import/export, and tabbed documents.

description.p: Crash fixes: reentrant state access that could close the app while opening files or editing.
New application IDs without the -rust suffix, and builds for aarch64.
Command palette, copy and paste between the three apps, autosave with crash recovery, and accessibility improvements.
Surfacing wave, measured format parity, oracle-verified DOCX/XLSX/PPTX/ODT/ODP, charts, footnotes, conditional formatting, master slides.
